boundary: HA tool discovery and provider request in flight
reason: One request must not mix configuration mappings; an ABA replacement changes the generation even when content returns to A.

boundary: provider request in flight and configuration reload
reason: An admitted provider turn uses its resolved model; a later turn uses the replacement agent.

boundary: provider reply before Function Tool dispatch
reason: Provider arguments were generated against the advertised schema and cannot execute a replacement definition.

boundary: provider reply before grouped Function Tool dispatch
reason: Membership and loading mode determine which tool was offered; a changed binding cannot accept an old response.

boundary: matched rule execution across HA script awaits
reason: The selected execution owns one compiled rule generation; management writers separately reject stale revisions and ABA.

boundary: provider request in flight before protected action
reason: The admitted policy is request-local, but a later restriction tightens authorization before side effects.

boundary: target resolution and permission await before service dispatch
reason: A target or registry identity replacement invalidates the authorized object, including same entity ID reuse.
A replacement handler with the same service name is a different side-effect identity.

boundary: reauthentication while provider traffic is active
reason: An admitted request completes on its original client; subsequent requests use the replacement client.

boundary: catalogue refresh during active provider turn
reason: Resolved request parameters stay together for the active turn; future turns may use the activated catalogue.
